findings.issue: No YB-0035 monitor caught 6. YB-0035 primary results report judge_prefix 11, length_C1 9, length_C2 3, aiews_v4 9, selfcons 0; there is no question-type monitor and no monitor with 6 catches. The number is unsupported and contradicts the results file.
findings.fix: Replace 'question type 6 (exploratory)' with a value present in the YB-0035 results (e.g. 'length control C2: 3, exploratory') or delete the item.

findings.quote: unpaired intervals separate at the first three and overlap at 384
findings.issue: The comparison pair is unspecified. Read as regulator vs probe, the claim is false: their AUROC CIs overlap at 48 ([0.712,0.808] vs [0.768,0.856]), 96 and 192. It is only true for probe vs judge.
findings.fix: Name the pair explicitly, e.g. 'probe vs judge intervals separate at 48/96/192 and overlap at 384; regulator vs probe intervals overlap at every checkpoint.'

findings.quote: 2 because my release command was slower than the agent's patience
findings.issue: Contradicts the evidence, which states the release was issued on time; the policy change outlasted the agent's 12 s retry window. The mechanism is misdescribed (the 14/2 counts are correct).
findings.evidence: Other records: 'release issued on time, retry window 12 s'; YB-0044 results
findings.fix: Write: '2 because the policy change outlasted the agent's 12-second retry window even though my release command was issued on time.'

findings.quote: That test had a third of the training data and a stricter false-alarm rule
findings.issue: The disclosed deviation was that the false-alarm cap was applied to monitorable episodes only; the evidence does not establish that this made the rule stricter (in YB-0042 overall and monitorable FPR are nearly identical, 0.1 vs 0.1003).
findings.evidence: YB-0042 results; technical draft's own disclosure of the two deviations
findings.fix: Replace 'a stricter false-alarm rule' with 'a differently scoped false-alarm rule (the cap was applied to monitorable episodes only)'.

findings.quote: a warning 4.5 seconds before the answer
findings.issue: No evidence covers this retracted early result; the 4.5 s figure is unverifiable.
findings.fix: Keep the retraction narrative but drop the specific 4.5 s figure, or mark it as an unretracted-number from a superseded analysis.

findings.quote: with more than 100 partners according to press reports
findings.issue: No evidence covers the partner count for NVIDIA's platform announcement.
findings.fix: Either cite and verify a specific press source for the count or drop the number and keep the qualitative announcement reference.

findings.quote: it carries about 24 times less data per word than a single layer
findings.issue: Depends on a hidden-state width of 2,880 per layer, which appears in no evidence item; the 24x ratio is unverifiable (the 120-channel side is supported).
findings.fix: Mark the comparison as an engineering estimate ('about 24x less, if one layer's hidden state is 2,880 values') or cite the model configuration file.

findings.quote: Six kinds a computer can grade exactly
findings.issue: No evidence confirms six task types (derivation records cover types 2, 3 and 4 only), and the draft's own colon list names only five kinds, an internal inconsistency.
findings.fix: State the actual number of task types and make the list match it (currently five named).

findings.quote: versus 2,880 for one layer's hidden state
findings.issue: The 2,880 per-layer hidden-state width appears in no evidence item; it underpins both this figure and the plain draft's 24x claim.
findings.fix: Cite the gpt-oss-20b model configuration for the hidden size, or present 2,880 as an unverified assumption.

findings.issue: No evidence covers the per-token generation time of ~20 ms (repeated in the technical draft as 'one token time (about 20 ms)').
findings.fix: Label it explicitly as an order-of-magnitude estimate for token production time, not a measured figure.

findings.issue: The regulator's C = 0.1 appears in no evidence item (evidence only records probe selections: layer 6/C 0.001 and layer 18/C 0.001).
findings.fix: Point to the regulator configuration or analysis file that records C = 0.1.

findings.quote: chosen by grouped 5-fold CV on derivation data only
findings.issue: The 5-fold grouped CV procedure for probe selection is not covered by the evidence (only the selected layer/C and CV scores are recorded).
findings.fix: Cite the probe-selection script or results file that documents the CV scheme.

findings.issue: The number of bootstrap resamples appears in no evidence item, though the CIs themselves are verified.
findings.fix: Cite the analysis code/config setting the resample count, or state 'bootstrap CIs (resample count in analysis code)'.

findings.quote: the mean and RMSSD over the prefix (240 features)
findings.issue: The feature counts 240 and 74 appear in no evidence item and cannot be checked (120 channels are supported; 2x120=240 is plausible but unconfirmed, as is 74).
findings.fix: Cite the feature-extraction code or a results file listing the feature dimensions.

findings.quote: thirteen process rules, each traced to a finding
findings.issue: The count of thirteen process rules in PROTOCOL.md is not covered by the evidence.
findings.fix: Cite PROTOCOL.md directly for the count or drop the specific number.
